dct_description_sm: The purpose of this dataset was to examine differences in soil moisture, active layer depth, and depth to mineral soil between alder shrub patches and non-patch tundra locations. There are several hypotheses predicting the responses of these variables to shrub expansion, but few studies directly compare differences between these two communities. This dataset was designed to address this knowledge gap in green alder communities.
dct_title_s: Abiotic Soil Data from Western Arctic, Inuvik Region
